info.name: OTA Core Engine
info.description: Auth (JWT) + real-Sabre-backed search/booking pipeline for core-engine-dotnet. Import the companion environment (OTA Core Engine (local)) alongside this collection. Run the "Auth" folder top to bottom first — each request's test script auto-captures variables (userId, accessToken, deviceToken, ...) into the environment for the next one. The gRPC folder's requests target shared/protos/ota.proto directly; if Postman doesn't auto-resolve the proto path on import, re-select it via the gRPC request's "protobuf definition" panel (Import a .proto file -> point at shared/protos/ota.proto) — one-time fix per machine.

request.description: Creates a brand-new agency + AgencyAdmin user (self-service signup, mirrors AeroTake's RegisteredUserController). For the rest of this collection we use the pre-seeded demo@skybridge.example user instead (see Login) so the flow doesn't depend on this succeeding, but it's here to prove registration works standalone.

Dev-seeded PlatformAdmin (admin@skybridge.example / Passw0rd!, tenant demo-tenant). Uses the pre-registered deviceToken so no email verify step. Saves {{adminAccessToken}} for markup-rules / exchange-rates / agencies. For B2C tenant markup use email admin@aerotake-b2c.example with X-Tenant-ID=aerotake-b2c (same password + deviceToken).

exec: pm.test('issued an access token (not device verification)', () => pm.expect(body.accessToken).to.be.ok);

request.description:
First login from an unrecognized device returns deviceVerificationRequired=true and emails a code (ported from AeroTake's device-verification flow, minus the hardcoded '123456' bypass). If SMTP isn't configured locally, read the code straight from the DB:

docker compose exec postgres psql -U ota -d ota -t -c "SELECT \"Code\" FROM \"VerificationCodes\" WHERE \"UserId\"='{{userId}}' ORDER BY \"CreatedAt\" DESC LIMIT 1;"

Paste the real code (from the email, or the DB query in the Login request's description) over REPLACE_WITH_CODE_FROM_EMAIL_OR_DB before sending. Success issues tokens AND a deviceToken — save that deviceToken; subsequent logins that send it back skip verification entirely.
Run this AFTER Verify Device has populated {{deviceToken}}. Should skip verification and return tokens directly.

exec: pm.test('200 OK, tokens issued directly', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().accessToken).to.exist; });

request.description: Always returns a generic success message regardless of whether the email exists (avoids user enumeration) — check the DB/email for the actual reset code.

Requires a valid access token — tenant is resolved from the JWT's claims, not a header, on authenticated routes. {{agentId}} defaults to blank; run "SQL: get seeded agent id" note in this folder's description or paste it from `docker compose exec postgres psql -U ota -d ota -t -c 'SELECT "Id" FROM "Agents" WHERE "Tier"=3;'`.
{{pnr}} is captured automatically by the gRPC "Create Booking" request's test script, once you've run that.
Negative-case check: no Authorization header should always be rejected.

exec: pm.test('401 Unauthorized without a token', () => pm.response.to.have.status(401));

item.name: REST — Agencies (Admin)
item.description: Admin-only agency management (C1). Needs {{adminAccessToken}} from Auth → Login as PlatformAdmin. Tier binds as a raw integer (1=Standard, 2=Silver, 3=Gold, 4=Platinum), not a string — no JsonStringEnumConverter is registered.

request.description: {{agencyId}} defaults to blank — paste one from "Create Agency" or "List Agencies".
Blocks the agency's users from logging in and blocks new bookings for this agency — see AuthController.Login and OtaCoreGrpcService.ProcessB2BBooking.

item.name: REST — Agent Tiers (Admin)
item.description: Admin-editable metadata (name/description/default/active) layered over the 4 fixed AgentTier enum slots (1=Standard, 2=Silver, 3=Gold, 4=Platinum) — the enum itself is NOT dynamic (it's part of the gRPC wire contract), this is a per-tenant config layer on top of it. Needs {{adminAccessToken}} — see the Agencies folder's note on obtaining one. Tier binds as a raw integer, not a string.

request.description: {{agentTierProfileId}} defaults to blank — paste one from "Create" or "List".

item.name: REST — Markup Rules (Admin)
item.description: Admin CRUD over MarkupRule, the pricing configuration ResolveMarkupRuleAsync reads live on every search/booking. ProductType MUST be one of: Unspecified, Flight, Hotel, Package, Activity, or "*" (wildcard) — these are the generated C# enum member names, NOT the proto's PRODUCT_TYPE_* wire names; sending the wire name is rejected. Needs {{adminAccessToken}}.

request.description: {{markupRuleId}} defaults to blank — paste one from "Create" or "List".
Takes effect immediately on the next search/booking for this tier+product — ResolveMarkupRuleAsync filters on IsActive live.

item.name: REST — Exchange Rates (Admin)
item.description: PlatformAdmin CRUD over global FX rates (pricing.ExchangeRates) that CurrencyConversion reads on every search/booking. Not tenant-scoped. Creating an open-ended rate closes any previous open row for the same From/To pair. DELETE soft-closes (sets EffectiveTo). Needs {{adminAccessToken}}. Sell currency remains Tenants.SellCurrency (provision script).

request.description: {{exchangeRateId}} is set by Create, or paste an id from List.
Sets EffectiveTo = now (audit trail kept). Takes effect on the next search/booking.

Requires a customer access token and a Pending B2C booking id. Returns gatewayUrl to open in the browser. Needs SSLCOMMERZ_STORE_PASSWORD and STOREFRONT_PUBLIC_URL on core. Saves paymentId/tranId/gatewayUrl.
Anonymous — no X-Tenant-ID. Real IPNs come from SSLCommerz with a real val_id; this probe only works after a sandbox payment. Localhost needs a public tunnel for live IPN.

gRPC unary call to ota.v1.OtaCoreService/GetSupplierAvailability. If Postman doesn't auto-link the proto on import: click "Select gRPC service" → Import a .proto file → shared/protos/ota.proto. Falls back to SupplierStub's deterministic fake data if SABRE_JV_CLIENT_ID/SECRET aren't set; hits real Sabre cert otherwise. Bump check_in to a date well in the future if you get no offers back (availability varies).

exec: pm.test('has at least one offer', () => pm.expect(body.offers && body.offers.length).to.be.above(0));

request.description: Run Search Availability first so {{offerId}}/{{offerNetRate}} are populated. Against real Sabre this also refreshes the cached offer with revalidate's own (more authoritative) segment data — required before Create Booking will succeed.

Reserves the PNR with the supplier — status comes back Pending, no credit debited yet (two-phase booking: pay/ticket happens in Issue Ticket). Against real Sabre, availability can genuinely change between search and book (a real GDS characteristic, not a bug) — if this returns FailedPrecondition, re-run Search + Revalidate and try again.

Pays via AgentCreditService (real ledger debit, verify with Get Agent Ledger afterwards) and tickets with the supplier. On any ticketing failure the credit is automatically released — check the ledger for the matching debit+refund pair.
